# dsh-alibaba-mcp
[](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-alibaba-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com
/package/dsh-alibaba-mcp) [](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](https://github.com/to
pics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

-party plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Not an official DeepSeek or Alibaba Cloud product. MIT licensed.
English | 中文
Connects the local Alibaba Cloud Ops MCP server and registers the tools that process publishes. They
show up as `mcp__alibaba__*`.
## What it does
The agent can call the Alibaba Cloud Ops server through uv. The plugin does not ship a copy of the s
erver and does not depend on a directory on this machine: it runs the `alibaba-cloud-ops-mcp-server`
distribution from PyPI and hands the connection to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`.
Access keys are read from the DSH credential store and passed only on the child environment. They ar
e not stored in `cordis.patch.yml`. The MCP client scrubs ambient names that look like keys, so a va
lue left only in the parent process environment would not reach the child.
If neither key is set, the plugin still starts the server. The server then uses its own credential c
hain. Saving a credential reconnects.
## How it works
1. Resolve `accessKeyIdEnv` and `accessKeySecretEnv` (defaults `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AL
IBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET`) through `ctx.credentials`. The store wins over the process environme

nt. Optional `securityTokenEnv` and `regionEnv` use the same path.
2. Refuse to spawn when only one
of the key pair is set, or when a security token is set without the pair. Also refuse when two cropp
ing switches are set at once: `codeDeploy`, `visibleTools`, and a `modules` value other than `all` a

re mutually exclusive.
3. Spawn `command` with `--transport stdio` and the selected server flags. Th
e child cwd is `cwd` when set, otherwise the directory that contains `command`, or the current direc

tory when `command` is a bare name resolved on `PATH`.
4. Mount one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` ch
ild. Tool names, schemas, and results come from the server. This package does not reimplement them.
5. When `credentials/reference-updated` fires for one of the four credential names, dispose that chi
ld and connect again.
Each tool call times out after 10 minutes. A dropped connection uses the MCP client's own reconnect
ol call times out after 10 minutes. A dropped connection uses the MCP client's own reconnect policy.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` writes the bundle into the profile. Res
tart DeepSeek Harness if the tools do not appear in the current session.
### Prerequisites
The server is a Python distribution, so it is started through uv. Install it once:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin checks for `uv` before it connects and reports the missing prerequisite instead of failin
g with a bare spawn error. It never installs anything by itself.
The Python version is pinned to **3.12** (`python` setting). This is not cosmetic: uv otherwise pick
s the newest interpreter it finds, and on CPython 3.14 the `pydantic-core` build fails, because its
PyO3 bindings support at most 3.13. If that build error appears, the machine's default interpreter i
s too new — uv downloads a managed 3.12 on first use.
Create an AccessKey in the Alibaba Cloud console, then set these credentials in this plugin's settin
gs, or export the same names in the environment that launches DeepSeek Harness:

- `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
- `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET`
`ALIBABA_CLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN` and `ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID` are optional.
## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `accessKeyIdEnv` | `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | Credential reference for the AccessKey ID. The

value is not kept in this config. |
| `accessKeySecretEnv` | `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` | Cre

dential reference for the AccessKey secret. |
| `securityTokenEnv` | `ALIBABA_CLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN`
| Optional STS token reference. Ignored when empty. A token without the key pair does not connect. |

| `regionEnv` | `ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID` | Optional region reference. Ignored when empty. |
| `com
mand` | `uv` | Stdio launcher. The default runs the server through uv; a bare name is looked up on `

PATH`. An absolute path is used as-is and checked before spawn. |
| `python` | `3.12` | Interpreter
passed to uv as `--python`. Pinned because uv would otherwise pick the newest interpreter available,

and CPython 3.14 breaks the `pydantic-core` build. |
| `cwd` | directory of `command` | Working dir
ectory of the child. Set this to a project root when using code deploy. Empty for a bare-name comman

d. |
| `serverName` | `alibaba` | Namespace for tool names: `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`. Must match

`[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}` and be unique among MCP clients in the same scope. |
| `services` | empty | Co
mma-separated service list passed as `--services`. Empty keeps the server default. Note that this do
es **not** reduce the tool surface: the server only uses it to register the common-API tools, so it

can even add tools. |
[该节后续省略]
## Security

- Resolved keys are sent only to the child process, as environment variables.
- This plugin's own lo

g lines do not print the keys. Client errors are redacted when they contain a resolved secret.
- Clo

ud tool arguments are sent to Alibaba Cloud by the upstream server.
- The upstream server can also l
ist local directories and run a local shell. This plugin does not add those tools; it does not remov

e them either. Use `visibleTools` to narrow the set.
- The plugin does not read the credentials file
directly and does not open a port.
See SECURITY.md.
## Compatibility
| Item | Value |

`0.2.2-rc.1` |
| Server | `alibaba-cloud-ops-mcp-server` 0.9.27 from PyPI, started through uv |
| R
equires | `credentials`, `tools`, the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, and uv on `PATH` |
Display metadata is `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, and `icon.svg`. There is no Web UI and no bu
etadata is `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, and `icon.svg`. There is no Web UI and no build step.
